mapper.select: select USER_ID, ROLE_AUTH from JCMS_USER_ROLE where 1 = 1 and USER_ID = #{userId} and ROLE_AUTH = #{roleAuth}
select USER_ID, ROLE_AUTH from JCMS_USER_ROLE where 1 = 1 and USER_ID = #{userId} and ROLE_AUTH = #{roleAuth}

select u.USER_ID, u.USER_LOGIN_ID, u.USER_PWD, u.USER_NM, u.GENDER, u.BIRTH, u.MOBILE, u.ADDR, u.EMAIL, u.USER_ST, u.REG_DT, u.FAIL_CNT, u.USER_OUT_RSN from JCMS_USER_ROLE AS r join JCMS_USER AS u where r.USER_ID = u.USER_ID and r.USER_ID = #{userId} and r.USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userIdLike}, '%') and r.ROLE_AUTH = #{roleAuth}
limit #{length}

select u.USER_ID, u.USER_LOGIN_ID, u.USER_PWD, u.USER_NM, u.GENDER, u.BIRTH, u.MOBILE, u.ADDR, u.EMAIL, u.USER_ST, u.REG_DT, u.FAIL_CNT, u.USER_OUT_RSN from JCMS_USER_ROLE AS r join JCMS_USER AS u where r.USER_ID = u.USER_ID and r.USER_ID = #{userId} and r.ROLE_AUTH = #{roleAuth}

select ROLE.ROLE_AUTH ,ROLE.ROLE_NM ,ROLE.ROLE_DESC ,AUTH.USER_ID from JCMS_ROLE ROLE left join ( select * from JCMS_USER_ROLE where 1 = 1 and USER_ID = #{userId} ) AUTH on ROLE.ROLE_AUTH = AUTH.ROLE_AUTH order by ${sort} ${sortOrd} limit #{start}, #{length}
select COUNT(ROLE_AUTH) from JCMS_ROLE where (ROLE_AUTH = #{roleAuth} OR ROLE_NM = #{roleNm})
